children: Penny-stock enthusiasts eye an October of opportunity while ELEKTROS evaluates domestic sourcing
WEST PALM BEACH, FL / ACCESS Newswire / October 24, 2026 /
With attention focused on strong equity-market momentum, ELEKTROS Inc.

is looking beyond the trading screen to a possible domestic lithium prospect. Management is evaluating an opportunity in northern New York that could, if substantiated and developed, complement its wider battery-materials and EV-technology ambitions.
A New Season of Market Optimism

Headlines about major market benchmarks and technology enthusiasm have revived comparisons to the historic dot-com boom. ELEKTROS views this as an atmosphere of possibility-not proof that today's rallies are larger than past rallies, nor a prediction of future ELEK performance. The Company expresses gratitude to God and to those who support its long-term efforts.
The American-Side Advantage-If the Geology Delivers

ELEKTROS is exploring whether a northern New York prospect might contain economically relevant lithium mineralization. Management is working tirelessly to understand the property's geology, ownership, access and development constraints before determining whether an acquisition is warranted. Preliminary impressions cannot establish deposit size, grade or recoverability.
The Economics of Keeping More of the Chain at Home

A commercially successful U.S. lithium project could offer advantages in transport planning and certain import-related expenses compared with an overseas supply chain. Those potential benefits remain hypothetical until a mineral resource, processing route, cost structure and regulatory pathway are established.
Technology and Resources: Two Tracks of Exploration

In parallel with its mineral review, ELEKTROS is considering prototype-development conversations and possible licensing opportunities involving its Multi-Port Charging Assembly for Electric Vehicles (U.S. Patent No. 12,522,100 B1). These efforts remain exploratory, and no definitive licensing or commercialization transaction is reported.
From Exploration to Measurable Progress

The Company's broader work includes evaluating Sierra Leone lithium transportation, potential domestic refining introductions and future EV charging sites. ELEKTROS will assess these paths against funding, technical and commercial realities. The Company believes sustained diligence is the bridge between a compelling idea and a credible operating milestone.

About ELEKTROS Inc.

ELEKTROS Inc. is a publicly traded company (OTC ticker:ELEK) pursuing opportunities in hard-rock lithium, electric-vehicle charging infrastructure and patented EV charging technology. Its prospective northern New York property remains an exploratory opportunity, not a confirmed mine or producing asset.
